steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So OwO the Archdemon sends her minions to attack the village again...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But this time, it's on a much larger scale. The villagers are no match against their attack.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, what are you going to do now? Will you come to their rescue, or will you flee?

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: Don't mind us, Lynn! Go find the candy! You must take care of yourself!

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: Go! You must find the candy of courage! You are our hope!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ... I... I will! I'll definitely find the candy!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I promise to come back and save everyone!
As the last flame of hope, Lynn leaves the village on a quest to find a way to defeat OwO the Archdemon.
